name: Sealed Envelope
summary: Fizziks has sealed Venture Company secrets inside the Sealed Envelope for delivery to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.

sections.title: Corporate Espionage
sections.body: After the Venture Company cast goblin engineer Fizziks out of its logging operations in the Stonetalon Mountains, he smuggled out company secrets. The envelope holds internal manuals, operating procedures, and technical specifications. Among them are schematics for the Super Reaper 6000, a machine built for industrial clear-cutting.

sections.title: Delivery to Ratchet
sections.body: Fizziks sends the documents south to Sputtervalve, an engineer in the neutral goblin port of Ratchet. The Steamwheedle Cartel's business rivals have little personal love or trust for Fizziks, yet the designs have undeniable engineering value. They reveal Venture Company mechanical ingenuity and give independent engineers a chance to exploit its advanced logging technologies.

faq.q: What is inside the Sealed Envelope?
faq.answer: The envelope holds internal Venture Company documents, technical manuals, and schematics for the Super Reaper 6000, a wood-clearing machine. Fizziks stole them when he left the company in haste.
Disgruntled goblin engineer Fizziks prepared the envelope after the Venture Company ejected him from its logging operation in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Who is intended to receive it?
faq.answer: The envelope is meant for Sputtervalve, a goblin tinkerer in the port town of Ratchet, within the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Sputtervalve want these documents?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve dislikes the Venture Company, and the documents offer valuable improvements and schematics that let outside tinkerers understand and adopt its powerful mechanical designs.

angles.text: The envelope holds technical drawings for the Super Reaper 6000, a destructive and lucrative machine devised by goblin hands.
Carrying these papers south from Stonetalon aids the neutral goblins of Ratchet in undermining the Venture Company's aggressive, exploitative logging operations.
